# Control Narrative: C-101 Ammonia Screw Compressor

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Document | CN-C101, Equipment Module C-101 |
| Revision | A, draft for review |
| Date | 2026-10-19 |
| Platform | Allen-Bradley CompactLogix PLC, HMI in engine room office |
| Standards | ANSI/ISA-5.06.01-2007, ANSI/ISA-106.00.01-2023, ISA-18.2, ASD-STE100 Issue 9 |

**Conventions**
- Each requirement has an ID (FR-C101-NNN) and a FAT test method.
- All numeric values are in Appendix A (setpoint list), and the text refers to them by ID (SP-nn).
- Values marked "confirm" are provisional. The integrator codes them as adjustable constants until they are confirmed.
- "Energized" and "de-energized" refer to PLC outputs. All protective discrete inputs are fail-safe: a closed contact means healthy.

---

## 1. Purpose and Boundaries

C-101 compresses ammonia vapor from the low-temperature suction header to the high-side discharge header. The PLC controls C-101 capacity to hold suction pressure at the setpoint. The PLC also starts and stops C-101, protects the machine, and runs the machine room ammonia detection response.

**In scope**
- C-101 start, stop, capacity control, and machine protection.
- Machine room ammonia detection response: EF-201 high speed, XV-120 closure, and shutdown of all compressors.
- Monitoring of the break-glass emergency shutdown station HS-130.

**Interfaces**

| Interface | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Suction header | Upstream | PT-101 measures the header pressure that C-101 controls. |
| Discharge header / condensers | Downstream | No control interface in this revision. See OI-08. |
| Soft starter (MCC) | PLC ↔ MCC | Run command, run feedback, top-of-ramp, fault. |
| Other compressors | PLC → other panels | Hardwired run permit XY-150. See OI-07. |
| EF-201 emergency exhaust fan | PLC → MCC | High-speed command and feedback. Normal ventilation control is by others. |
| XV-120 machine room main liquid solenoid | PLC → valve | Energize to open. |
| HS-130 break-glass station | Hardwired + PLC input | Hardwired stop of compressors and XV-120. PLC status input. |

**Out of scope:** evaporator liquid feed, condenser control, EF-201 normal-speed ventilation, and any safety instrumented function (see Section 6.4).

---

---

## 3. States and Transitions (ISA-106)

C-101 uses state-based control. Start and stop are sequences inside the STARTING and STOPPING states (Section 5).

### 3.1 State Table

| ID | State | Description | Outputs | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S0 | OUT OF SERVICE | Removed from service for maintenance. | YS-101, ZY-105L, ZY-105U de-energized | Manual |
| S1 | NOT READY | Stopped. One or more start permissives (Table 6-1) are not met. | YS-101, ZY-105L, ZY-105U de-energized | Automatic |
| S2 | READY | Stopped. All start permissives are met. | YS-101, ZY-105L, ZY-105U de-energized | Automatic |
| S3 | STARTING | SEQ-1 runs. | Per SEQ-1 | Operator-prompted start, then automatic |
| S4 | RUNNING | C-101 runs. PIC-101 controls capacity. | YS-101 energized, slide valve per Section 4 | Automatic (PIC-101 Auto) or Manual |
| S5 | STOPPING | SEQ-2 runs. | Per SEQ-2 | Operator-prompted, then automatic |
| S6 | TRIPPED | A trip (Table 6-2) stopped C-101. Latched. | YS-101, ZY-105L, ZY-105U de-energized | Automatic entry, manual reset |
| S7 | EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN | Ammonia high-high or break-glass. Latched. | YS-101, ZY-105L, ZY-105U, XY-120, XY-150 de-energized. YS-201H energized. | Automatic entry, manual reset |

### 3.2 Transition Table

| ID | From | To | Condition | Initiator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T01 | S1 | S2 | All permissives in Table 6-1 are met. | Auto |
| T02 | S2 | S1 | Any permissive in Table 6-1 is lost. | Auto |
| T03 | S2 | S3 | Operator pushes START and confirms the prompt. | Operator |
| T04 | S3 | S4 | SEQ-1 completes. | Auto |
| T05 | S3 | S1 | SEQ-1 step 1 fails (start abort before motor start). | Auto |
| T06 | S3, S4 | S5 | Operator pushes STOP and confirms the prompt. | Operator |
| T07 | S5 | S1 or S2 | SEQ-2 completes. Goes to S2 if all permissives are met, otherwise S1. | Auto |
| T08 | S3, S4, S5 | S6 | Any trip cause in Table 6-2. | Auto |
| T09 | S6 | S1 | All trip causes are clear and the operator pushes RESET. | Operator |
| T10 | Any | S7 | ESD cause in Table 6-3 (IL-20 or IL-21). | Auto |
| T11 | S7 | S1 | All ESD causes are clear and the operator pushes ESD RESET. | Operator |
| T12 | S1, S2 | S0 | Supervisor selects OUT OF SERVICE. | Supervisor |
| T13 | S0 | S1 | Supervisor selects IN SERVICE. | Supervisor |

No other transitions are allowed.

### 3.3 Requirements

| ID | Requirement | FAT test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-C101-001 | C-101 is in exactly one state from Table 3-1 at all times. The HMI shows the state name. | Drive each transition in Table 3-2. Verify that the HMI state matches. |
| FR-C101-002 | The PLC blocks all transitions not in Table 3-2. | Push START in S0, S1, S3, S4, S5, S6, and S7. Verify no change to YS-101 and no state change. |
| FR-C101-003 | In S0, S1, S2, S6, and S7, the PLC keeps YS-101, ZY-105L, and ZY-105U de-energized. | Force each state. Monitor the outputs. |
| FR-C101-004 | Only a supervisor login can select OUT OF SERVICE or IN SERVICE. The selection is only possible in S1 or S2. | Try the selection with operator login, and with supervisor login in S4. Verify rejection. Repeat with supervisor login in S2 and verify acceptance. |
| FR-C101-005 | On PLC power-up, C-101 goes to S7 if any ESD cause is active or latched. Otherwise it goes to S6 if a latched trip is retained. Otherwise it goes to S1. C-101 does not start automatically. | Cycle PLC power under each of the three conditions. Verify the state and that YS-101 stays de-energized. |

## 4. Regulatory Control

### 4.1 PIC-101 Suction Pressure Capacity Control

| Item | Specification |
|---|---|
| PV | PT-101 |
| Setpoint | Default SP-01. Adjustable from SP-02 to SP-03 by supervisor login only. |
| Output | Slide valve LOAD pulses (ZY-105L) and UNLOAD pulses (ZY-105U). |
| Action | Direct. When PV is above the setpoint plus the deadband (SP-30), the PLC sends LOAD pulses. When PV is below the setpoint minus the deadband, the PLC sends UNLOAD pulses. Within the deadband, there are no pulses. |
| Pulse timing | Pulse width SP-31. Minimum interval between pulses SP-32. |
| Active states | S4 only. In S3, SEQ-1 holds the slide valve. In S5, SEQ-2 forces unload. |
| Modes | AUTO: PIC-101 makes the pulses. MANUAL: each push of LOAD or UNLOAD makes one pulse of width SP-31. |
| Mode on start | AUTO at the end of SEQ-1. |
| Mode change | A mode change does not move the slide valve. |
| Cascade | None. |

### 4.2 Capacity Overrides

The overrides apply in AUTO and MANUAL. A higher priority overrides a lower priority. The HMI shows each active override.

| Priority | Condition | Action | Release |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | S6 or S7 | No pulses. YS-101 de-energized. | State exit |
| 2 | S5 (SEQ-2 step 1) | Continuous UNLOAD pulses at the pulse timing | Step complete |
| 3 | II-104 at or above SP-16 | Force UNLOAD pulses | II-104 below SP-15 |
| 4 | PT-101 at or below SP-06 | Force UNLOAD pulses | PT-101 above SP-05 |
| 5 | II-104 at or above SP-15, or II-104 bad PV | Inhibit LOAD | II-104 below SP-15 and healthy |
| 6 | PT-101 at or below SP-05 | Inhibit LOAD | PT-101 above SP-05 |
| 7 | ZT-105 at or above SP-23B | Inhibit LOAD | ZT-105 below SP-23B |
| 8 | ZT-105 at or below SP-23A | Inhibit UNLOAD | ZT-105 above SP-23A |
| 9 | S3 (SEQ-1 steps 1 to 4) | Inhibit LOAD | SEQ-1 step 5 |
| 10 | None of the above | PIC-101 AUTO or MANUAL operator pulses | — |

### 4.3 Requirements

| ID | Requirement | FAT test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-C101-010 | In S4 with PIC-101 in AUTO, the PLC makes LOAD pulses when PT-101 is above the setpoint plus SP-30. It makes UNLOAD pulses when PT-101 is below the setpoint minus SP-30. It makes no pulses within the deadband. | Simulate PT-101 above, inside, and below the band. Monitor ZY-105L and ZY-105U. |
| FR-C101-011 | Each pulse has width SP-31. Pulses on the same output are separated by no less than SP-32. | Measure pulse trains with the PLC trend or a timer. |
| FR-C101-012 | In MANUAL, each push of LOAD or UNLOAD makes one pulse. Holding the button does not make more pulses. | Push and hold each button. Count the pulses. |
| FR-C101-013 | The overrides in Table 4-2 apply in AUTO and MANUAL, in the listed priority. | Simulate each condition in AUTO and in MANUAL. Then simulate conflicting conditions (for example, priority 3 and priority 10 LOAD demand). Verify the result. |
| FR-C101-014 | Only a supervisor login can change the PIC-101 setpoint. The PLC rejects values outside SP-02 to SP-03, keeps the old value, and shows a message. | Enter a value with operator login. Enter values below SP-02 and above SP-03 with supervisor login. Verify rejection. |
| FR-C101-015 | The PLC retains the PIC-101 setpoint through a power loss. | Change the setpoint. Cycle PLC power. Verify the value. |
| FR-C101-016 | A change between AUTO and MANUAL causes no pulse. | Change mode while monitoring the outputs. |
| FR-C101-017 | The HMI shows each active override by name. | Activate each override. Verify the indication. |

---

## 5. Sequences

### 5.1 SEQ-1 Start (state S3)

**CAUTION:** Make sure that the slide valve is at minimum before motor start. A loaded start can cause high inrush current and soft starter trip.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Make continuous UNLOAD pulses. | ZT-105 at or below SP-24 | SP-25 | Stop pulses. Go to S1 (T05). Alarm A-17. The PLC does not count a start. |
| 2 | Energize YS-101. Add one to the start counter (FR-C101-032). | YI-101 closed | SP-26 | Trip IL-06. Go to S6. |
| 3 | Start the oil bypass timer (SP-10). Inhibit LOAD. | YI-101R closed | SP-27 | Trip IL-07. Go to S6. |
| 4 | Keep LOAD inhibited. | Oil bypass timer done and PDT-102 above SP-09 | Ends when the oil bypass timer is done | Trip IL-02 is active at the end of the bypass. Go to S6. |
| 5 | Set PIC-101 to AUTO. Release the LOAD inhibit. | Immediate | Not applicable (one-scan action) | Not applicable |
| End | Go to S4 (T04). | — | — | — |

If ZT-105 has a bad PV, the PLC does not allow a start (permissive P-07).

### 5.2 SEQ-2 Normal Stop (state S5)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Make continuous UNLOAD pulses. | ZT-105 at or below SP-24 | SP-28 | Go to step 2. Alarm A-18. |
| 2 | De-energize YS-101. Stop the pulses. | YI-101 open | SP-29 | Keep YS-101 de-energized. Stay in S5. Alarm A-16 (fail to stop). The HMI prompts: "C-101 did not stop. Open the C-101 disconnect or operate HS-130." |
| End | Go to S2 if all permissives are met, otherwise go to S1 (T07). | — | — | — |

If ZT-105 has a bad PV during step 1, the PLC continues the UNLOAD pulses for the full SP-28 time and then goes to step 2.

A trip (T08) or ESD (T10) during SEQ-2 de-energizes YS-101 at once and ends the sequence.

### 5.3 Requirements

| ID | Requirement | FAT test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-C101-030 | SEQ-1 runs the steps in Table 5-1, with the listed transitions, timeouts, and failure responses. | Run a normal start with simulated feedbacks. Then fail each step's transition in turn. Verify each timeout and failure response. |
| FR-C101-031 | SEQ-2 runs the steps in Table 5-2, with the listed transitions, timeouts, and failure responses. | Run a normal stop. Then hold ZT-105 high. Then hold YI-101 closed. Verify each response. |
| FR-C101-032 | The PLC counts each energization of YS-101. If the count in the last SP-20 window is at SP-19, the PLC blocks START (permissive P-03). The HMI shows the starts remaining and the time until the next start is allowed. The count is retentive through power loss. | Make SP-19 starts with simulated feedback. Verify that the next START is blocked and that the countdown shows. Cycle PLC power. Verify that the count is retained. Advance the clock or wait for the window. Verify that START is allowed again. |
| FR-C101-033 | STOP during S3 goes to S5. If YS-101 is not yet energized, SEQ-2 ends without energizing YS-101. | Push STOP during SEQ-1 step 1 and step 4. Verify the result. |
| FR-C101-034 | A failure at SEQ-1 step 1 does not add to the start counter. | Fail step 1. Verify the count. |

---

## 6. Interlocks and Permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was supplied. Tables 6-1 to 6-4 are the C&E rows for C-101. All trips act directly on the outputs, without SEQ-2 unload. Each trip delay is in Appendix A.

### 6.1 Start Permissives

| ID | Permissive | Auto-reset |
|---|---|---|
| P-01 | No trip is active or unreset (S6 is not active). | Yes |
| P-02 | No ESD is active or unreset (S7 is not active). | Yes |
| P-03 | The start count in the SP-20 window is below SP-19. | Yes, when the window clears |
| P-04 | PT-101 is above SP-05 and healthy. | Yes |
| P-05 | TT-103 is below SP-12 and healthy. | Yes |
| P-06 | PDT-102 is healthy. | Yes |
| P-07 | ZT-105 is healthy. | Yes |
| P-08 | YA-101 is closed (no soft starter fault). | Yes |
| P-09 | YI-101 is open (motor not running). | Yes |
| P-10 | At least one of AE-110A or AE-110B is healthy (OI-10). | Yes |
| P-11 | HS-130 is closed (break-glass not operated). | Yes |
| P-12 | XY-150 is energized (no all-compressor shutdown active). | Yes |

### 6.2 C-101 Trips (effect: de-energize YS-101 and ZY-105L/U, go to S6)

| ID | Cause | Active states | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IL-01 | PT-101 at or below SP-04 for SP-07 | S3, S4, S5 | Latched | Cause clear, then RESET at HMI |
| IL-02 | PDT-102 at or below SP-09 for SP-11, after the oil bypass time (SP-10) | S3 (after bypass), S4, S5 | Latched | Cause clear, then RESET at HMI |
| IL-03 | TT-103 at or above SP-13 for SP-14 | S3, S4, S5 | Latched | Cause clear, then RESET at HMI |
| IL-04 | Bad PV on PT-101, PDT-102, or TT-103 for SP-34 (PDT-102 bad PV is ignored during the oil bypass) | S3, S4, S5 | Latched | Signal healthy, then RESET at HMI |
| IL-05 | YA-101 open (soft starter fault) | S3, S4, S5 | Latched | Soft starter reset at MCC, then RESET at HMI |
| IL-06 | Fail to start: YI-101 not closed within SP-26 of YS-101 energized | S3 | Latched | RESET at HMI |
| IL-07 | Ramp fail: YI-101R not closed within SP-27 | S3 | Latched | RESET at HMI |
| IL-08 | Uncommanded stop: YI-101 opens while YS-101 is energized, after SEQ-1 step 2 | S3, S4 | Latched | RESET at HMI |
| IL-09 | PLC input module fault on a module that carries an IL-01 to IL-08 input | S3, S4, S5 | Latched | Module healthy, then RESET at HMI |

### 6.3 Ammonia Detection and Emergency Shutdown

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IL-20 | AE-110A or AE-110B at or above SP-22 (either detector) | Go to S7. De-energize YS-101, XY-120 (close XV-120), and XY-150 (stop all other compressors). Energize YS-201H (EF-201 high speed). | Latched | Both detectors below SP-22, then ESD RESET at HMI |
| IL-21 | HS-130 open (break-glass operated) | **Hardwired, without the PLC:** HS-130 opens the C-101 soft starter control circuit, the XV-120 coil circuit, and the run circuits of all other compressors. **PLC:** go to S7 and apply the IL-20 effects. | Latched (mechanically at HS-130 and in the PLC) | Restore HS-130, then ESD RESET at HMI |
| IL-22 | AE-110A or AE-110B at or above SP-21 (either detector) | Energize YS-201H (EF-201 high speed). Alarm A-11. | Latched | Both detectors below SP-21, then GAS RESET at HMI |
| IL-23 | AE-110A or AE-110B bad PV for SP-34 | Energize YS-201H. Alarm A-13 (confirm, OI-10). | Latched | Signal healthy, then GAS RESET at HMI |
| IL-24 | AE-110A and AE-110B both bad PV | IL-23 effects. Block START (P-10). Alarm A-14. A running C-101 continues (confirm, OI-10). | Auto-reset for P-10. Latched for EF-201. | Signal healthy, then GAS RESET at HMI |
| IL-25 | YS-201H energized and YI-201H not closed within SP-35 | Alarm A-15 | Auto-reset | Feedback closes |

ESD RESET re-energizes XY-120 (opens XV-120) and XY-150. ESD RESET does not reset EF-201 high speed. GAS RESET does that. Neither reset starts C-101.

### 6.4 Relation to the SIS

No IEC 61511 SRS was supplied. IL-20 and IL-21 are specified here as BPCS and hardwired functions. The hazard study must decide if they are safety instrumented functions (OI-05). If they are, they move to the SRS. This narrative then only references them.

### 6.5 Requirements

| ID | Requirement | FAT test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-C101-040 | The PLC allows START only when all permissives in Table 6-1 are met. The HMI shows each permissive and its status. | Remove each permissive in turn in S2. Verify T02 and the indication. |
| FR-C101-041 | Each cause in Table 6-2 causes its listed effect within one PLC scan plus the listed delay. | Simulate each cause in S4. Measure the time to YS-101 de-energized. |
| FR-C101-042 | Each cause in Table 6-3 causes its listed effect. | Simulate each cause in S4. Verify every listed output. |
| FR-C101-043 | Trips and ESD stay latched after the cause clears, until the listed reset. RESET does not start C-101. | Clear each cause. Verify the latch. Reset. Verify S1 or S2 and no start. |
| FR-C101-044 | RESET has no effect while any cause is active. The HMI shows "cause still active". | Push RESET with the cause active. |
| FR-C101-045 | The HMI has no bypass for any trip, ESD, or permissive. | Inspect the HMI screens and the operator and supervisor access lists. |
| FR-C101-046 | HS-130 stops C-101 and closes XV-120 with the PLC in program mode or powered off. | Put the PLC in program mode with C-101 run circuit energized by test jumper per FAT procedure. Operate HS-130. Verify the soft starter control circuit and XV-120 coil open. |
| FR-C101-047 | The PLC shows the first-out trip or ESD cause. | Simulate two causes in sequence. Verify that the HMI shows the first. |
| FR-C101-048 | The oil bypass inhibits IL-02, A-04, and PDT-102 bad-PV trip only for SP-10 from YI-101 closed. | Hold PDT-102 low at start. Verify trip at the end of the bypass, not before. |

---

## 7. Alarms

No rationalized alarm database was supplied. The table lists the alarms this module needs. The priorities are provisional until ISA-18.2 rationalization (OI-18).

| ID | Tag / source | Condition | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A-01 | PT-101 | Below SP-05 (load inhibit) | Medium | Check the suction header and evaporator load. Make sure that the setpoint is correct. |
| A-02 | PT-101 | Trip IL-01 | High | Find the cause of low suction. Reset only when PT-101 is above SP-05. |
| A-03 | II-104 | At or above SP-17 for SP-36 | Low | Make sure that capacity unloads. Check the discharge pressure and condenser. |
| A-04 | PDT-102 | Below SP-08 for SP-11 (suppressed during the oil bypass and in S0, S1, S2, S6, S7) | Medium | Check the oil level and oil filter. Prepare for a controlled stop. |
| A-05 | PDT-102 | Trip IL-02 | High | Do not restart until the oil system is checked. |
| A-06 | TT-103 | At or above SP-12 | Medium | Check the oil cooling and the discharge pressure. Reduce the load if needed. |
| A-07 | TT-103 | Trip IL-03 | High | Do not restart until the oil cooling is checked. |
| A-08 | PT-101, PDT-102, TT-103 | Bad PV (IL-04) | High | Call maintenance to check the instrument and wiring. |
| A-09 | II-104, ZT-105 | Bad PV | Medium | Call maintenance. C-101 runs with LOAD inhibited (II-104) or with no new start (ZT-105). |
| A-10 | YA-101, IL-06, IL-07, IL-08 | Soft starter fault, fail to start, ramp fail, uncommanded stop | High | Check the soft starter display and the MCC. |
| A-11 | AE-110A/B | At or above SP-21 (IL-22) | High | Do not go into the machine room without the PPE and procedure in the emergency response plan. Find the leak. |
| A-12 | AE-110A/B, HS-130 | ESD (IL-20, IL-21) | Urgent | Follow the ammonia emergency response plan. |
| A-13 | AE-110A or B | Bad PV, one detector | High | Call maintenance. EF-201 runs at high speed. |
| A-14 | AE-110A and B | Bad PV, both detectors | Urgent | There is no gas detection. Start the manual gas watch procedure. Call maintenance. |
| A-15 | EF-201 | Fail to run at high speed (IL-25) | High | Check EF-201 at the MCC. |
| A-16 | C-101 | Fail to stop (SEQ-2 step 2) | High | Open the C-101 disconnect or operate HS-130. |
| A-17 | ZT-105 | Start unload timeout (SEQ-1 step 1) | Low | Check the slide valve hydraulics. |
| A-18 | ZT-105 | Stop unload timeout (SEQ-2 step 1) | Low | Check the slide valve hydraulics. |
| A-19 | PLC | Input or output module fault | High | Call the controls technician. |

"Start limit reached" (P-03) is an HMI status message, not an alarm.

| ID | Requirement | FAT test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-C101-050 | The PLC generates each alarm in Table 7-1 at the listed condition, with the listed priority. | Simulate each condition. Verify the alarm, priority, and time stamp on the HMI alarm summary. |
| FR-C101-051 | The PLC suppresses A-04 in the listed states and during the oil bypass. | Hold PDT-102 low in S2 and during SEQ-1 step 4. Verify no alarm. Hold it low in S4. Verify alarm. |

---

## 8. Abnormal Handling

### 8.1 Bad PV

A signal is bad when it is outside the limits in SP-33 for SP-34, or when its input channel reports a fault.

| Tag | Effect of bad PV | Latched |
|---|---|---|
| PT-101 | Trip IL-04. Block start. | Yes |
| PDT-102 | Trip IL-04 (after the oil bypass). Block start. | Yes |
| TT-103 | Trip IL-04. Block start. | Yes |
| II-104 | Inhibit LOAD (override priority 5). Alarm A-09. C-101 continues to run. | No |
| ZT-105 | Alarm A-09. Block start (P-07). C-101 continues to run. PIC-101 continues, with no position limits. SEQ-2 uses the timed unload. | No |
| AE-110A or AE-110B | IL-23 and IL-24 | Per Table 6-3 |

### 8.2 Communications Loss

| Loss | Detection | Response |
|---|---|---|
| HMI to PLC | HMI heartbeat not changed for SP-37 | The PLC continues all control and protection. C-101 stays in its present state. The HMI shows "COMMS FAIL" and greys all values. No START, setpoint change, or reset is possible. On restore, the PLC ignores commands that were sent during the loss. |
| PLC to I/O module | Module fault status | Output modules are configured to go to OFF on fault. Input modules: IL-09 trips C-101. Alarm A-19. |
| Gas detection network (if used) | See OI-14 | Treat as bad PV on both detectors (IL-24). |

### 8.3 Power Loss and Restart

| Event | Response |
|---|---|
| PLC control power lost | All outputs de-energize. C-101 stops. XV-120 closes. XY-150 stops all other compressors (confirm, OI-07). EF-201 high-speed command drops. |
| PLC control power restored | FR-C101-005 applies. C-101 does not restart. XV-120 stays closed until the operator pushes ESD RESET (confirm, OI-12). EF-201 high speed restarts at once if IL-22, IL-23, or IL-24 is latched or active. The PLC retains latched trips, the ESD latch, the start counter, the setpoint, and the first-out record. |
| MCC power lost, PLC healthy | YI-101 opens. IL-08 trips C-101. |
| PLC first scan | The PLC holds all outputs de-energized until it has read all inputs once. |

### 8.4 Fail Positions

| Device | Failure state |
|---|---|
| C-101 (YS-101 de-energized) | Stopped |
| Slide valve (ZY-105L/U de-energized) | Holds position (OI-02) |
| XV-120 (XY-120 de-energized) | Closed |
| EF-201 high speed (YS-201H de-energized) | Off (OI-15) |
| Other compressors (XY-150 de-energized) | Stopped (OI-07) |

## 9. Operator Interface

### 9.1 C-101 Faceplate (engine room office HMI)

The faceplate shows:
- State name (Table 3-1) and active SEQ-1 or SEQ-2 step.
- PT-101 PV and PIC-101 setpoint, with PIC-101 mode.
- Slide valve position (ZT-105).
- Motor current II-104 in percent FLA.
- PDT-102 and TT-103.
- Oil bypass time remaining during SEQ-1.
- Starts remaining in the SP-20 window and the time until the next start is allowed.
- Active overrides by name (Table 4-2).
- Permissive status (Table 6-1).
- First-out trip or ESD cause.

### 9.2 Gas Detection Panel

The panel shows AE-110A and AE-110B values and health, EF-201 high-speed status, XV-120 command state, HS-130 status, XY-150 state, and the ESD and gas latch status.

### 9.3 Commands and Access

| Command | Access | Prompt |
|---|---|---|
| START | Operator | "Start C-101? Make sure that the area near C-101 is clear. Push CONFIRM." |
| STOP | Operator | "Stop C-101? C-101 unloads and then stops. Push CONFIRM." |
| RESET (trip) | Operator | "Reset the C-101 trip? C-101 does not start after the reset. Push CONFIRM." |
| AUTO / MANUAL | Operator | None |
| LOAD / UNLOAD (MANUAL) | Operator | None |
| GAS RESET | Operator (confirm, OI-17) | "Reset the gas alarm? EF-201 goes back to normal control. Push CONFIRM." |
| ESD RESET | Operator (confirm, OI-17) | See warning below. |
| Setpoint change | Supervisor | Entry box shows the SP-02 to SP-03 limits. |
| OUT OF SERVICE / IN SERVICE | Supervisor | "Remove C-101 from service? Push CONFIRM." |

**ESD RESET prompt:**

> **WARNING:** Do not reset the emergency shutdown until the ammonia leak is found and stopped. The reset opens XV-120 and lets all compressors start again. Push CONFIRM to reset.

| FR-C101-072 | Operations signs off the states, prompts, and access levels before FAT. | Signed record (OI-17). |
